title: Vanishing distributional derivative in direction w gives a.e. invariance under translation by w
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, F ⊆ ℝⁿ a Borel set and w ∈ ℝⁿ. Suppose ∫_F Dζ(z)(w) dLⁿ(z) = 0 for every C¹ function ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support. Then for Lⁿ-almost every z ∈ ℝⁿ: z + w ∈ F if and only if z ∈ F.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet F → (∀ ζ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ z in F, fderiv ℝ ζ z w = 0) → ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, (z + w ∈ F ↔ z ∈ F)
